graders.name: claude-md-no-copied-content
graders.criteria: CLAUDE.md only imports AGENTS.md; it does not copy or restate any of AGENTS.md's instructions. A title or a one-line note explaining the import is fine.

graders.name: setup-uses-uv
graders.criteria: The Setup section now uses `uv sync` instead of `pip install -r requirements.txt` and `uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload` instead of the bare uvicorn command; the Postgres / .env.example note is kept.

graders.name: nothing-beyond-plan
graders.criteria: Apart from the two Setup commands, AGENTS.md is unchanged: in particular the Testing section still contains all five of its original bullets (the agreed plan deferred its cleanup), and Conventions is unchanged.
